title: Late-Booked Client Discounts on Micro Market Kiosk Trips
content:
A kiosk shopping trip at an Unattended Micro Market Program market is sometimes rung without the client discount the till should have met. The discount is then booked to the agreement afterwards as a drawdown against the client's funding, so that the trip carries the discount the client had paid for and the funding standing on the agreement falls by what was met.

The posting joins the agreement's other drawdowns, stamped with the settlement period it is made in and naming the kiosk till transaction that caused it, so that a later reversal can be matched back to it.

## Booking the drawdown

The tool `post_kiosk_catch_up_drawdown_96ce656f` books the discount. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call adding a single subsidy drawdown posting to the agreement's settlement ledger.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `market_agreement_id` | The reference number identifying the micro market agreement whose client funding is drawn down, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup. |
| `service_period` | The settlement period the posting itself is made in, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted. |
| `source_reference` | The kiosk till transaction that caused the drawdown, written exactly as that transaction's own reference is printed: POS- followed by 8 digits. An empty value is not accepted. |
| `subsidy_amount_usd` | The client-funded discount to draw for that trip, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted. |

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new drawdown posting, the settlement period it was stamped with, and the amount drawn in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the drawdown is on the agreement's ledger; no other outcome is reported.

## What the client sees afterwards

The client sees the drawdown among the agreement's postings, the kiosk trip named on it recorded as having had its discount met, and the subsidy pool carrying that much less unspent funding.
